entries.title: I Peter 3:1
segments: ¶Likewise, wives, [be] subject to your own husbands, that, even if any are disobedient to the word, they may be gained without [the] word by the conversation of the wives,

entries.title: I Peter 3:2
segments: having witnessed your pure conversation [carried out] in fear;

entries.title: I Peter 3:3
segments: whose adorning let it not be that outward one of tressing of hair, and wearing gold, or putting on apparel;

entries.title: I Peter 3:4
segments: but the hidden man of the heart, in the incorruptible [ornament] of a meek and quiet spirit, which in the sight of God is of great price.

entries.title: I Peter 3:5
segments: For thus also the holy women who have hoped in God heretofore adorned themselves, being subject to their own husbands;

entries.title: I Peter 3:6
segments: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord; whose children ye have become, doing good, and not fearing with any kind of consternation.

entries.title: I Peter 3:7
segments: [Ye] husbands likewise, dwell with [them] according to knowledge, as with a weaker, [even] the female, vessel, giving [them] honour, as also fellow-heirs of [the] grace of life, that your prayers be not hindered.

entries.title: I Peter 3:8
segments: ¶Finally, [be] all of one mind, sympathising, full of brotherly love, tender hearted, humble minded;

entries.title: I Peter 3:9
segments: not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing; but on the contrary, blessing [others], because ye have been called to this, that ye should inherit blessing.

entries.title: I Peter 3:10
segments: For he that will love life and see good days, let him cause his tongue to cease from evil and his lips that they speak no guile.

entries.title: I Peter 3:11
segments: And let him avoid evil, and do good; let him seek peace and pursue it;

entries.title: I Peter 3:12
segments: because [the] eyes of [the] Lord [are] on [the] righteous, and his ears towards their supplications; but [the] face of [the] Lord [is] against them that do evil.

entries.title: I Peter 3:13
segments: And who shall injure you if ye have become imitators of that which [is] good?

entries.title: I Peter 3:14
segments: But if also ye should suffer for righteousness' sake, blessed [are ye]; but be not afraid of their fear, neither be troubled;

entries.title: I Peter 3:15
segments: but sanctify [the] Lord the Christ in your hearts, and [be] always prepared to [give] an answer [to] every one that asks you to give an account of the hope that [is] in you, but with meekness and fear;

entries.title: I Peter 3:16
segments: ¶having a good conscience, that [as to that] in which they speak against you as evildoers, they may be ashamed who calumniate your good conversation in Christ.

entries.title: I Peter 3:17
segments: For [it is] better, if the will of God should will it, to suffer [as] well-doers than [as] evildoers;

entries.title: I Peter 3:18
segments: ¶for Christ indeed has once suffered for sins, [the] just for [the] unjust, that he might bring us to God; being put to death in flesh, but made alive in [the] Spirit,

entries.title: I Peter 3:19
segments: in which also going he preached to the spirits [which are] in prison,

entries.title: I Peter 3:20
segments: heretofore disobedient, when the longsuffering of God waited in [the] days of Noah while the ark was preparing, into which few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water:

entries.title: I Peter 3:21
segments: ¶which figure also now saves you, [even] baptism, not a putting away of [the] filth of flesh, but [the] demand as before God of a good conscience, by [the] resurrection of Jesus Christ,

entries.title: I Peter 3:22
segments: who is at [the] right hand of God, gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being subjected to him.
